items.name: SpillManager
items.summary: The `SpillManager` is responsible for the following tasks: - Reading and writing `RecordBatch`es to raw files based on the provided configurations. - Updating the associated metrics.

methods.name: create_in_progress_file
methods.summary: Creates a temporary file for in-progress operations, returning an error message if file creation fails. The file can be used to append batches incrementally and then finish the file when done.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(env: Arc<RuntimeEnv>, metrics: SpillMetrics, schema: SchemaRef) -> Self

methods.name: read_spill_as_stream
methods.signature: fn read_spill_as_stream(&self, spill_file_path: Arc<dyn SpillFile>, max_record_batch_memory: Option<usize>) -> Result<SendableRecordBatchStream>
methods.summary: Reads a spill file as a stream. The file must be created by the current `SpillManager`; otherwise an error will be returned.

methods.name: read_spill_as_stream_unbuffered
methods.signature: fn read_spill_as_stream_unbuffered(&self, spill_file_path: Arc<dyn SpillFile>, max_record_batch_memory: Option<usize>) -> Result<SendableRecordBatchStream>

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Returns the schema for batches managed by this SpillManager

methods.name: spill_record_batch_and_finish
methods.signature: fn spill_record_batch_and_finish(&self, batches: &[RecordBatch], request_msg: &str) -> Result<Option<Arc<dyn SpillFile>>>
methods.summary: Spill input `batches` into a single file in a atomic operation. If it is intended to incrementally write in-memory batches into the same spill file, use [`Self::create_in_progress_file`] instead. None is returned if no batches are spilled.
